ability.name: Kunai Strike
ability.text: Throw kunai at the target for 145/220/380% AD + 10/15/25 AP physical damage (+35/52/80% AD if Burning). AP form deals magic damage instead. Recasts on kill.
ability.simNote: AD form only: single-target physical hit. Burning bonus and recast ignored.

ability.name: Defensive Sweep
ability.text: Slice the target for 150/225/400% AD + 10/15/25 AP physical damage and gain a 60/90/200 Shield for 2 seconds.
ability.simNote: As described.

ability.name: Razor Leaves
ability.text: Five leaves converge on the target for 310/465/700% AD + 30/45/70 AP physical damage, applying 20% Wound and 1% Burn for 4s. Scarlet Buff: gain 22% AD per cast.
ability.simNote: Single-target physical hit + permanent 22% AD per cast. Wound/Burn ignored.

ability.name: Karmic Bond
ability.text: Tether the target for 280/420/630 magic damage over 1.5s, then burst for 125/185/300 magic damage to enemies within 1 hex and slow their Attack Speed by 30% for 2s.
ability.simNote: Tether as instant hit; burst as 1-hex AoE; slow ignored.

ability.name: Dance of Life
ability.text: Restore 7% max HP + 285/335/480 AP Health over 2s (18.4). Next attack bashes for 10% max HP + 70/105/150 AP magic damage.
ability.simNote: Heal applied instantly; empowered next attack.

ability.name: Shield Bash
ability.text: Passive: start combat with 60/80/100 bonus Armor and MR decaying over 12s. Active: bash the target for 150/270/405% Armor as magic damage and Stun for 1.5s.
ability.simNote: Decaying resists modelled as full bonus for the first 6s.

ability.name: Bellows Breath
ability.text: Gain a 400/460/550 Shield for 4s and deal 200/300/450 magic damage to enemies in a cone. Quest: forge Artifacts from damage blocked.
ability.simNote: Cone approximated as target + 1 hex. Quest (items) ignored.

ability.name: Azure Laser
ability.text: Channel a laser consuming 35% max Mana per second: 160/240/360 magic damage per second to the target and -3 MR per second.
ability.simNote: Channel (~3s) modelled as a 3s damage-over-time on the target.

ability.name: Entrancing Dance
ability.text: Gain a 290/340/435 Shield for 4s, then grant the ally with the most damage dealt 90/100/130% decaying Attack Speed for 4s.
ability.simNote: Decaying AS modelled as half the value for the full 4s.

ability.name: Uproot
ability.text: Passive: restore 1% max HP + 10/14/20 Health per second (tripled for 3s after casting). Active: lunge out of the ground, Stunning adjacent enemies for 1s and dealing 70/105/160 AP magic damage.
ability.simNote: Regen modelled without the post-cast triple.

ability.name: Piercing Arrow
ability.text: Fire an arrow through the most enemies in line with the target for 415/625/1000% AD + 30/45/70 AP physical damage, reduced by 40% per enemy passed (min 40%).
ability.simNote: Line approximated as target + enemies within 1 hex, with falloff.

ability.name: Primordial Burst
ability.text: Blast the target for 190/285/430 AP magic damage, increased to 285/430/640 below 30% max HP (18.4). On kill, permanently gain 2% AP.
ability.simNote: Execute bonus modelled; permanent AP stacking ignored.

ability.name: Deadly Plumage
ability.text: Gain 50% Attack Speed for the next 5 attacks; they become feathers dealing 73/108/165 physical damage and reducing Armor by 2.
ability.simNote: 5 empowered attacks + 50% AS for ~5s. Armor reduction ignored.

ability.name: Last Rites
ability.text: Passive: on death, spawn a Spirit Walker (200/400/750 + 20% HP) that taunts. Active: restore 280/325/435 AP Health and strike the target for 150/225/340% AD physical damage.
ability.simNote: Spirit Walker summon not simulated.

ability.name: Triumphant Roar
ability.text: Cleanse, heal 230/300/400 + 8% max HP, heal the 2 lowest-HP allies for 80/105/130, deal 180/270/420 magic damage to the target and Stun for 1.5s.
ability.simNote: Cleanse ignored.

ability.name: Headshot
ability.text: Every 3rd attack is a Headshot dealing 200/300/490% AD + 20/30/45 AP physical damage (18.5).
ability.simNote: Mana is an attack counter (1 per attack).

ability.name: Spider Queen
ability.text: Transform into a spider: +375/475/725 max HP; attacks deal 35/50/80 bonus magic damage and heal 55/90/170. Later casts grant 175% decaying Attack Speed for 4s.
ability.simNote: First cast: max HP + on-hit magic for rest of combat. Later casts: +85% AS for 4s.

ability.name: Belchy Bubble
ability.text: AP form: bubble explodes on the first enemy hit for 225/340/535 AP magic damage, then 180/270/435 AP magic damage over 3s in 1 hex. Purple Buff: +30% AP every 5s.
ability.simNote: AP form only. Purple Buff ignored.

ability.name: Solar Judgement
ability.text: Passive (no mana). Ascensions by level: attacks deal 65/97/110 bonus magic damage; then 20% Shred; then waves of 35 magic damage; then infinite range.
ability.simNote: Only the 1st Ascension (on-hit magic damage) is simulated.

ability.name: Mirror Image
ability.text: Launch a mirror image at the target: 260/390/615 AP magic damage, 100/150/230 AP to adjacent enemies. Passive: 10/15/30% chance to copy an ally after combat (+4% per takedown).
ability.simNote: Copy passive ignored.

ability.name: Rending Claws
ability.text: Leap to the lowest-Health enemy within 3 hexes for 100/150/225% AD + 20/30/45 AP physical damage. Next 2 attacks gain 175% AS and deal 65/100/160% AD bonus physical damage. Grey Buff: Precision + 25–75% crit chance.
ability.simNote: Leap retargets; 2 empowered attacks. Grey Buff ignored.

ability.name: Can You Dig It?
ability.text: Passive: attacks become a dance hitting all adjacent enemies. Active: burrow, gaining 15% Durability for 3s and healing 325/400/675. Green Buff: allies below 50% restore 15% max HP.
ability.simNote: Cleave modelled; Green Buff ignored.

ability.name: Sun's Wrath
ability.text: Gain a 225/250/275 + 10% max HP Shield for 4s, cleave a cone for 90/135/205 magic damage and strike a line for 120/180/270 magic damage.
ability.simNote: Cone = target + 1 hex; line = target + 1 hex.

ability.name: Ki Barrier
ability.text: Shield self for 375/450/575 and a nearby damaged ally for 225/300/400 for 4s. Both gain +40% AS and 35/55/80 bonus magic damage on their next 3 attacks.
ability.simNote: Ally = lowest-HP ally. Empower applies to Shen only.

ability.name: Fungus Among Us
ability.text: Throw 2 mushroom clusters at the 3 nearest enemies (55/82/155 magic each) and a giant mushroom at the target (135/200/310 magic). May forage loot.
ability.simNote: Loot ignored.

ability.name: Jaws of The Beast
ability.text: Bite the target for 230/345/535% AD physical damage, heal 25% of damage dealt and gain 20% Attack Speed for the rest of combat.
ability.simNote: As described (AS stacks per cast).

ability.name: Cultivation of Spirit
ability.text: Dash, then launch an orb at the target for 160/240/370% AD + 10/15/25 AP physical damage. It splits into 2 nearby enemies for 35% of that.
ability.simNote: Dash ignored.

ability.name: Arise!
ability.text: Gain 150% AS for the next 6 attacks and summon 2 soldiers; attacks command the soldiers, each dealing 43/65/105 magic damage (18.5 nerf from 46/69/110).
ability.simNote: Soldiers modelled as 6 empowered attacks dealing 2 soldier hits each.

ability.name: Noxious Blast
ability.text: Poison the target and the nearest non-poisoned enemy for 425/630/1020 magic damage over 15s. Poisons stack.
ability.simNote: Target + nearest enemy each receive the full poison.

ability.name: Pale Barrier
ability.text: Gain a 150/275/500 Shield for 2s and launch 6 moonlight orbs spread among enemies within 2 hexes, each dealing 75/115/180 magic damage.
ability.simNote: Orbs distributed round-robin among enemies within 2 hexes.

ability.name: Harvest
ability.text: Reduce the MR of the 3 nearest enemies by 10, then drain them over 2s for 70/105/170 magic damage each, healing 410/485/850.
ability.simNote: Drain = 2s DoT on 3 nearest + instant heal.

ability.name: Spirit of Dread
ability.text: Gain 50 Armor and MR for 3s and heal 375/475/685 over the duration. Launch riders at the 3 nearest enemies: 80/120/195 magic damage and Stun 1.5/1.5/1.75s.
ability.simNote: Heal applied instantly.

ability.name: Taste Their Fear
ability.text: Leap to the farthest enemy within 3 hexes for 230/310/450 AP magic damage (18.5 mid-patch, 27 Oct). Isolated targets take 250/350/530 AP instead and refund 10 Mana.
ability.simNote: Leap retargets the farthest enemy within 3 hexes.

ability.name: Raining Artillery
ability.text: Launch acid at the target and the nearest other enemy for 145/220/375% AD + 20/30/50 AP physical damage; 140% damage to enemies below 50% HP.
ability.simNote: As described (AD form).

ability.name: Rock and Roll
ability.text: Gain 175/225/325 max HP, then roll into the target for 135/200/335% AD + 8% max HP damage. On death split into two taunting Kruglettes.
ability.simNote: Kruglettes / Slate Buff not simulated.

ability.name: Flock Family
ability.text: Summon 4 untargetable Tiny Beaks for 5s; whenever Mama Beak attacks they attack the same enemy for 20/30/50% AD physical damage each (18.5). Orange Buff: -2 Armor per hit.
ability.simNote: Tiny Beaks = +4 hits of on-hit physical damage for 5s.

ability.name: Wuju Style
ability.text: Every 3rd attack is a Double Strike that grants stacking Attack Speed (12%, more with Adaptor). AD form starting AD 63 (18.5).
ability.simNote: The 3rd attack becomes two attacks + 12% permanent AS.

ability.name: Defensive Ball Curl
ability.text: Taunt nearby enemies; for 4s gain a 400/550/700 AP Shield (18.4) and 60 Armor/MR. When the Shield breaks, deal 50/75/120% Armor + 50/75/120% MR physical damage within 2 hexes.
ability.simNote: Shield-break damage applied when the cast ends.

ability.name: Savagery
ability.text: Jump to the lowest-%HP enemy within 3 hexes and stab for 255/385/650% AD physical damage. Heal 60/90/90 AP, up to 120/180/180 based on target missing HP.
ability.simNote: Heal uses the average of min/max.

ability.name: Explosive Charge
ability.text: Attach a charge to the target for 4s; gain infinite range and 60% AS. It then explodes for 175/265/420% AD + 12/18/28% AD per attack made meanwhile, split among enemies within 2 hexes (18.5).
ability.simNote: Explosion assumes ~6 attacks while charged. Mana 0/50 after 18.5.

ability.name: Furious Fists
ability.text: Passive: attacks restore 2% max HP. Active: heal 200/265/360, gain 85/100/125% AS and 15% Durability, Unstoppable for 3s.
ability.simNote: AS buff assumed to last 3s (same as Unstoppable).

ability.name: Spirit Bomb
ability.text: Target the spot within 4 hexes with the most enemies; explode in a 3-hex radius for 455/685/3500 magic damage, falling off 21% per hex from the centre.
ability.simNote: Densest enemy cluster within 2 hexes; falloff per hex.

ability.name: Tantrum
ability.text: Passive: every second heal 2.5% max HP + 20/25/100 and deal 12/18/150 magic damage within 1 hex. Active: 100/150/2000 magic damage within 2 hexes and Stun 1/1/6s (longer if Burning).
ability.simNote: Burning stun extension ignored.

ability.name: Moonlight's Onslaught
ability.text: Swipe the target 5 times over 2s for 70/105/850% AD physical damage each, then fire a blast for 450/675/5000% AD + 40/60/225 AP physical damage split among enemies within 2 hexes.
ability.simNote: Swipes as one hit; blast split in a 2-hex area.

ability.name: Crimson Fury
ability.text: For 8s gain 100/100/300% bonus AD and ignore 30% + 10% AP Armor (18.5 mid-patch). Passive: on target death, leap at the next target for 135/205/1000% AD. Red Buff: attacks Burn and heal 4% max HP (18.5b).
ability.simNote: Leap passive ignored. Armor ignore = 30% + 10% × AP/100. Red Buff heal modelled as on-hit heal.

ability.name: Forest's Flurry
ability.text: Blink away and deal 270/405/1200% AD physical damage (18.4); gain 30/30/100% Attack Speed. Every 4th cast: a blast through the largest group for 385/580/2500% AD.
ability.simNote: Every-4th-cast blast ignored. AS gain stacks per cast.

ability.name: Lilting Lullaby
ability.text: Heal 350/525/800 and send 4 butterflies at nearby enemies for 90/135/2000 magic damage, putting them to Sleep for 1.5/1.75/8s (woken by 1000 damage).
ability.simNote: Sleep modelled as a stun.

ability.name: Petrified Bark
ability.text: Gain a 735/885/2000 AP Shield for 4s (18.5). When it breaks, deal 40/60/2000 AP + 30/45/999% Armor + 30/45/999% MR magic damage within 2/2/3 hexes.
ability.simNote: Burst lands when the shield expires (4s) with the 1★ armor scaling baked in.

ability.name: Withering Curse
ability.text: Passive: 25% Omnivamp. Blast up to 3 nearby enemies for 70/105/500 magic damage (18.5) and Curse them for 4s, creating a zone dealing 33/50/500 per second. Cursed enemies take 25/38/240 bonus damage.
ability.simNote: Curse bonus ignored; zone = 4s DoT around target.

ability.name: Javelin Toss
ability.text: AP form: next 3 attacks gain 150% AS and become javelins dealing 185/275/2000 magic damage; the 3rd hits the farthest enemy for 330/500/3000. AD form: cougar assassin.
ability.simNote: AP form; 3 empowered attacks averaging the javelin values.

ability.name: Azure Shockwave
ability.text: Gain a 375/475/2000 + 10% max HP Shield for 4s (18.5), send a fissure toward the most enemies for 100/150/3500 magic damage, knocking up for 0.5s (18.5) and Mana Reaving. Blue Buff: allies gain 2 Mana Regen per cast.
ability.simNote: Fissure approximated as densest cluster; Mana Reave ignored.

ability.name: Haymaker
ability.text: Passive: first time below 40% HP gain 100 Mana. Active: heal 12% max HP + 250/300/2000 AP (18.5), then punch a large cone for 150/225/5000% AD + 6% max HP physical damage.
ability.simNote: Cone = target + 1 hex. Heal % component applied to missing HP.

ability.name: Boomerang Blade
ability.text: Throw a crossblade at the target for 220/330/1050% AD + 15/20/100 AP physical damage (18.5); it bounces 8 times for 18% of the initial hit.
ability.simNote: Bounces spread round-robin among enemies within 2 hexes of the target.

ability.name: Starcall
ability.text: Call a star on the target for 235/355/1000 magic damage (18.5). If a star already fell on them, call 3 more stars for 110/165/1000 magic damage each (18.5).
ability.simNote: Marks the target; re-casting on a marked target adds 3 stars.

ability.name: Rampant Growth
ability.text: Spawn 2/2/4 plants that attack the nearest enemy 10 times for 35/53/225 magic damage each.
ability.simNote: Plants modelled as a 5s DoT on the target.

ability.name: Moonfall
ability.text: Rain 9 moonshards split among the 3 nearest enemies for 58/88/500 magic damage each (18.5). Full moon: crash the moon for 2350/3600/7500 split among all enemies.
ability.simNote: Full-moon cast ignored; each of 3 nearest takes 3 shards.

ability.name: Spirit Rift
ability.text: Fire an arrow through the most enemies for 465/700/1000% AD physical damage (-80/80/40% per enemy, min 20%), leaving a 3s rift dealing 11/16% AD + 2/3/20 + 1.5% max HP physical damage per second and slowing.
ability.simNote: Line approximated; rift = 4s DoT around the target (max-HP part ignored).

ability.name: Whirling Death
ability.text: Passive: attacks bleed for 150/225/3000% AD physical over 12s (18.4). Active: two axes at the enemy with most bleeds (100/150/400% AD each), consuming bleeds instantly; axes return for 30/45/100% AD.
ability.simNote: Axes hit the current target and pop its remaining bleeds.

ability.name: Heat Without Equal
ability.text: Passive: attacks deal 75/75/100% damage to enemies adjacent to the target; executes enemies below 12% HP. First cast: fly up (invulnerable), Stun all enemies 1.25s, gain 15% Omnivamp, ignite. Then Flame Breath: 285/435/7000% AD + 20/30/200 AP physical in a line.
ability.simNote: Ignite ignored. First cast = stun all + omnivamp; every cast = Flame Breath.

ability.name: Rage Gene
ability.text: Rage (5/s + 5 per attack). Transform into Mega Gnar: leap into the largest group within 3 hexes for 100/150/2000 physical within 2 hexes, Shred 15/20/250, Stun 1s, gain 400/600/15000 HP. Then Grab n' Throw: 380/570/9000 to the target, 135/205/4500 to enemies passed.
ability.simNote: Transform on first cast; Grab n' Throw on later casts.

ability.name: Greenfather
ability.text: Shield 2/2/10 allies for 185/350/3000 and grant 10/15/100% Damage Amp for 6s; after 6s deal 155/235/2000 magic damage to enemies adjacent to them.
ability.simNote: Delayed burst lands around Ivern's target.

ability.name: Firestorm
ability.text: Gain 15% AP per Burning enemy and a 230/300/3000 Shield for 2.5s. Rush through a group for 80/120/1500 magic damage, then create a 2-hex storm dealing 475/715/5000 split over 2s.
ability.simNote: Burning AP gain ignored.

ability.name: Final Spark
ability.text: Fire a laser at the largest group for 375/565/6500 magic damage (falling off 25% per enemy). Passive: allies sharing a trait gain 3 Mana when she casts. (Avatar: chosen trait counts twice.)
ability.simNote: Base Lux only — Avatar trait choice not simulated.

ability.name: Sow the Seeds
ability.text: Deal 69/124/3726 magic damage to the target and restore 330/400/2000 + 10% missing HP. Passive: saplings jump at enemies after blocking damage and on death.
ability.simNote: Saplings not simulated.

ability.name: Emerald Radiance
ability.text: Passive: first time Taric or his pair drops below 50% HP, shield allies within 3 hexes. Active: restore 275/450/3000 HP; Taric and his pair deal 130/200/1000 bonus magic damage on their next 2 attacks (18.5). Resists 70 (18.5).
ability.simNote: Pairing and passive shield not simulated.

adaptor.name: Adaptor
adaptor.description: Adaptors use whichever of AD or AP is higher and gain +25/35/50%.
adaptor.simNote: Both AD and AP bonuses are granted (the real trait picks the higher one).

apex_predator.name: Apex Predator
apex_predator.description: Elder Dragon takes 2 board slots and counts as +2 Riftbeast.
apex_predator.simNote: Adds +2 to the Riftbeast count. Board-slot cost ignored.

attuned.name: Attuned
attuned.description: Alune shifts the moon phase after each cast: at or below half moon +5% Durability (18.5), above +7% Damage Amp.
attuned.simNote: Alternates between the two bonuses on each cast, starting with Durability.

avatar.name: Avatar
avatar.description: Avatars turn other Avatars in the shop into their chosen trait; that trait counts twice.

blackthorn.name: Blackthorn
blackthorn.description: An ally on the Blackthorn hex is sacrificed to give the team max Health (175/350/600). 18.5: 6-piece enhanced bonus 60%→50%.
blackthorn.simNote: Team Health bonus granted without sacrificing a unit.

blossom.name: Blossom
blossom.description: Upgrades Wisps (shop). Blossom champions gain AD/AP and 10% max Health.
blossom.simNote: Combat stats only; Wisp economy not simulated.

bounty_seeker.name: Bounty Seeker
bounty_seeker.description: Choose a bounty; Draven progresses it.

brawler.name: Brawler
brawler.description: Team gains 120 max Health; Brawlers gain +25/40/65% max Health.

caustic.name: Caustic
caustic.description: Caustic damage Shreds and Sunders enemies by 30% for 4 seconds.
caustic.simNote: Every damage instance from the Caustic unit refreshes the reduction.

coven.name: Coven
coven.description: Gain Essence on kills and losses (economy).

defender.name: Defender
defender.description: Team gains 12 Armor and Magic Resist; Defenders gain 25/60/115 instead.
defender.simNote: Team gets the team value; Defenders get the Defender value instead.

eclipse.name: Eclipse
eclipse.description: Activated by fielding 3 Solar and 3 Lunar. After 8s of combat, kill the lowest-Health enemy every 3.5s.
eclipse.simNote: Active when ≥3 Solar and ≥3 Lunar unique units are on the team.

elderwood.name: Elderwood
elderwood.description: Places Elderwood plants (Stonebark Tree, Lifebloom, Deepwood Protector) that grow stronger. 18.5: 9-piece summon Health 140%→125%.
elderwood.simNote: Plant summons are not simulated yet.

emerald_aspect.name: Emerald Aspect
emerald_aspect.description: Pair an ally with Taric to share his ability bonuses.

executioner.name: Executioner
executioner.description: Executioners gain Precision and 15% Critical Strike Chance (2); enemies bleed for bonus true damage (3); bleed rises (4).

params.label: Bleed (bonus true dmg % of damage dealt)

executioner.simNote: Precision ignored; the 3 s bleed is applied instantly as bonus true damage.

fae.name: Fae
fae.description: Damage, healing and shielding attract Pixies granting AD/AP and a heal at low Health (18.5: 3/5%).
fae.simNote: Pixie thresholds ignored; bonuses granted at combat start.

flora_fatalis.name: Flora Fatalis
flora_fatalis.description: Takedowns grant 10 Mana (1); also heal the lowest-Health ally for 7% max Health (2, 18.5).

greenfather.name: Greenfather
greenfather.description: Gain seeds when Ivern casts; every 5 seeds grow a buffing hex.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.description: Hunters gain +20/30/40/60% AD. Hunters that keep their target gain 10% Damage Amp after 3 seconds.

params.label: Damage Amp after 3s on same target (%)

hunter.simNote: Damage Amp applies once a Hunter has attacked the same target for 3s.

inferno.name: Inferno
inferno.description: Burn and Wound enemies; ignite shop slots after combat.

params.label: Burn (% max HP true dmg / s)

inferno.simNote: Inferno damage applies a 3s Burn + Wound. Shop ignite not simulated.

invoker.name: Invoker
invoker.description: Team gains Mana Regen; Invokers gain more.
invoker.simNote: Invokers receive the higher value instead of the team value.

juggernaut.name: Juggernaut
juggernaut.description: Team gains Durability; Juggernauts gain more.
juggernaut.simNote: Juggernauts receive the higher value instead of the team value.

lunar.name: Lunar
lunar.description: Lunar champions and adjacent allies gain Attack Speed and AP; Lunar champions gain double.
lunar.simNote: Adjacency is checked at combat start — positioning matters.

monolith.name: Monolith
monolith.description: Gain 10 Armor and MR for each enemy targeting this unit.

old_growth.name: Old Growth
old_growth.description: Each enemy death within 3/10/10 hexes gives the strongest Old Growth 30/100/1000 permanent max Health (by Maokai star).
old_growth.simNote: Gains Health in combat (not carried between fights).

primal.name: Primal
primal.description: Choose a Primal Blessing (2), then a second one (4).

rapidfire.name: Rapidfire
rapidfire.description: Team gains 10% Attack Speed. Rapidfire champions gain AS per attack (18.5: 3/5/7/10%), up to 10 stacks.

ravager.name: Ravager
ravager.description: Ravagers gain 10% Omnivamp and 12/25/40% bonus damage, doubled against units below 50% Health.

riftbeast.name: Riftbeast
riftbeast.description: Alpha Mark (3); overrun shops every 3 combats (5); Riftbeasts grow every 5 seconds (7, 18.5: AD/AP 6%→5%); +2 team size (10).
riftbeast.simNote: Only the 7+ growth effect is combat-relevant here; Alpha Mark and shop effects not simulated.

rival.name: Rival
rival.description: Only your strongest Rival is active; Rivals collect takedowns.

solar.name: Solar
solar.description: Team gains a 5% max Health Shield and 8% bonus magic damage, +1% each per unique 3-star.
solar.simNote: Higher 3-star thresholds (AS/resists, true damage, ascension) not simulated.

spellweaver.name: Spellweaver
spellweaver.description: Team gains 10 AP; Spellweavers gain 10/30/55 AP and more AP each cast.
spellweaver.simNote: Spellweavers get the Spellweaver value instead of the team value (sources do not say whether it stacks).

sprykin.name: Sprykin
sprykin.description: Gain the Big Furry Friend and pick a Rider; bonus Health and Attack Speed.
sprykin.simNote: Big Furry Friend not summoned; bonuses applied to Sprykin units.

summoner.name: Summoner
summoner.description: Empowers summons (Yorick, Azir, Mama Beak, Zyra).

thornmaiden.name: Thornmaiden
thornmaiden.description: Team gains 5% Durability, or 10% with 6+ Zyra plants alive.

vanguard.name: Vanguard
vanguard.description: Vanguards gain a max-Health Shield at combat start and when first below 50% Health (18/30/40%). (6): 5% Durability while shielded.
